<Heading

  children={"Finish and get next request"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/finish"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The backend calls this method to finish the current request and receive the next one.
The response body holds the next request: `request_type` is `advance_state` or `inspect_state`, and `data` holds the request.
For advance-state requests, `data` contains the input metadata and the payload; for inspect-state requests, only the payload.

Set `status` to `accept` or `reject` for the request that was just processed. The status of the first call, made before any request was received, has no effect.

If an advance-state request is rejected, its notices and vouchers are discarded and the machine returns to the state it had before the input. Reports are kept.
For an inspect-state request, the status is returned to the caller in the inspect response (`Accepted` or `Rejected`); an inspect never changes the machine state.

The call blocks until the node sends the next request.
